suggestions.title: Gnats Every Time You Open the Lid? Emergency Trap Inside the Terrarium Jar
suggestions.reason: The quarantine step tells readers to place a sticky trap at the jar opening but gives no build or placement detail; this guide shows exactly how to trap adults inside a jar without disturbing the enclosure.
suggestions.anchor: Place one yellow sticky trap just above the soil
suggestions.quote: Place one yellow sticky trap just above the soil. Cut it small to fit inside the jar or place it next to the lid opening.

suggestions.quote: And do not just trap adults. Traps alone never solve it.

suggestions.reason: Supports the article's prevention advice by explaining that most infestations begin with gnat eggs already present in bagged soil and substrate, so readers understand why quarantining new materials matters.

suggestions.title: Foggy Terrarium Terrarium Jar? How to Reduce Condensation Without Drying It Out
suggestions.reason: Constant fog is the moisture condition that keeps topsoil gnat-friendly; this guide shows how to rebalance condensation in a sealed jar without desiccating the plants, addressing the root cause behind the outbreak.
